Add a text watermark to a PDF

Type the watermark, set its size, angle, color and transparency, preview it on the pages, and download the stamped PDF.

How to watermark a PDF

  1. Choose the PDF you want to watermark.
  2. Type the text and adjust its size, angle, color and transparency.
  3. Select Add watermark and download.

How your files are handled

Your files are opened, changed and saved by this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, and the original file on your device is never modified. Closing the tab discards everything, so download your result first.

Questions

Are my files uploaded?
No. Everything runs in your browser with PDF.js and pdf-lib. Your documents are never sent to a server.
Can the watermark be removed?
The watermark is drawn into each page’s content, but anyone with a PDF editor can still remove it. For sensitive documents, also use redaction or share a flattened copy.
Can I add an image watermark?
Not in this tool yet. To place a logo, use the editor’s Image tool on the pages you need.
Is it free?
Yes. There is no account, no watermark, no daily limit and no paid tier.
